metadata.description: A carefully curated collection of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: kernel
plugins.description: Universal cognitive kernel. Stack-agnostic thinking patterns, memory management, and planning tools.

plugins.name: panel
plugins.description: Adversarial agent teams. Verification that cannot be self-issued. Standalone; pairs well with kernel.

plugins.name: laravel-ddd
plugins.description: Domain-driven design patterns for Laravel. Standalone; pairs well with kernel.

plugins.name: laravel-playbook
plugins.description: The package author's playbook. Ecosystem-wide patterns for crafting, shipping, and sustaining pinnacle Laravel packages.

plugins.name: pest
plugins.description: Pest v3 testing syntax and patterns. Standalone; pairs well with kernel.

plugins.name: signal
plugins.description: Plain English harness. States the budget before the agent writes, and reads what came back.

plugins.name: floor
plugins.description: Where work happens. A run is one attempt at one work item, held outside every repository it changes.
